messages:
Maria Lopez: Heads up — I'm opening a PR to update the localization & region-availability doc. Need an explicit example for calling EU endpoints and a short footnote about data residency for hosted EU accounts. Also need Node/Python SDK snippets showing the new 'region' parameter. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412
AJ Chen: Thanks — can you also include an ap-southeast-1 (Sydney) example and call out that private deployments might use different hostnames/URLs? Also verify alias hosts (api.redwood.ai vs eu.api.redwood.ai).
Kevin Huang: I'll review the snippets. For Node: suggest example using client.configure({ region: 'eu-west-1' }). For Python: Client(region='ap-southeast-1'). Make sure we mention fallback behavior to global endpoints and when caching/kv is region-bound.
Maria Lopez: Draft Node snippet pasted in PR:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'eu-west-1' });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-7b', input: 'translate: Hello' });
```Also added a short sentence: "EU endpoints process and retain data in the EU for hosted accounts; private deployments follow customer infra configuration."
Samira Patel: Small wording tweak: prefer "data is processed and stored in the selected region for hosted accounts" instead of "retain". Also add a legal/engagement sentence: "Customers in regulated sectors should contact sales for residency agreements."
legal-bot: Auto-check: please include link to DPA and SOC2 page: https://redwood.ai/compliance/dpa. Recommend adding: "Contact legal@redwood.ai for custom residency agreements."
AJ Chen: Can we add a short migration snippet for customers currently pointing at the global API? Example: change base URL to https://eu.api.redwood.ai and show minimal curl/SDK examples.
Maria Lopez: Added migration curl example to the PR:```bash
curl -X POST https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-7b","input":"hi"}'
```Also added a one-line note about rate-limiting and quota alignment when switching regions.
docs-ci: Link-check complete: 17/17 internal links validated. One external vendor link flagged (external geo-map) — pinging @Kevin Huang to reconcile or replace with internal asset.
Kevin Huang: Replaced the external vendor map with our internal region table and updated the doc. Also recommending we add a small availability matrix (GA / preview / coming soon) for each region to avoid confusion.
Samira Patel: From product writing side: LGTM pending legal confirmation on the residency phrasing. :+1:
Maria Lopez: Great — I'll update the availability table and merge after legal confirms. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
